result.reason: The revised clause correctly creates a mutual cap equal to the greater of twelve months’ paid or payable Fees and USD 1,000,000. However, the operative language does not define “Excluded Claims” or otherwise establish the required carve-outs; the margin comment’s description of Sections 21.2 and 21.3 cannot substitute for supplied operative language. The clause also does not include the preferred mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages or clarify that Customer payment obligations are not damages. Without verifiable carve-outs for at least indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence, and wilful misconduct, even the fallback position is not established. The changes are otherwise focused and preserve the mutual-liability structure.
